sector_model: Large-cap advertising and AI infrastructure: revenue growth, operating margin, FCF after capex and finance leases, funding mix (debt, preferred, forward equity), non-cancelable commitments, legal accruals; P/E distorted by tax and legal items.
thesis: Meta Platforms (Nasdaq: META). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-22) read. Revenue Q3 64.60B (+26%), 9M 181.71B (+29%). Income from operations Q3 12.99B (-37%) including a 9.89B multistate attorneys general charge (11.89B in 9M); 9M operating income 54.64B vs 58.53B. TTM revenue 241.6B (200.966-141.073+181.712); TTM NI 75.2B (60.458-37.690+52.481); TTM operating income 79.4B; TTM OCF 133.1B (115.8-79.586+96.873); TTM PP&E purchases 104.4B (69.691-48.308+83.055) plus finance lease principal 3.5B (2.524-1.770+2.769), so TTM FCF about 25.1B. 2026 capex guide 135-145B (incl. finance leases) vs 85.8B spent in 9M, implying roughly 49-59B in Q4 (own arithmetic). Non-cancelable commitments 454.5B (45.85B due 2026, 121.41B 2027). Funding: 25B senior notes in May 2026; Oct 2026 6.50% mandatory convertible preferred (250M depositary shares at 1/20 of a 1,000 preference share, so about 12.5B before over-allotment, my arithmetic) and forward sale of 40M Class A shares at an initial 622.92 (about 24.9B on settlement by 2027-11-19, own arithmetic); EUR 9.0B senior notes issued 2026-11-12 (8-K). Debt face 84.0B at 2026-09-30; cash and securities 82.45B (of which restricted cash equivalents 12.83B separately). No buybacks in 9M 2026; preferred terms restrict common dividends and buybacks if preferred dividends are unpaid. Close 560.84 (2026-11-20, two sources agree; -10.4% from 626.41 on 11-16, cause not found) x 2,556.2M Class A plus B shares (2,214,472,367 + 341,768,886 at 2026-10-16) = 1,433.6B market cap: 19.1x TTM NI (distorted by a lower tax charge: 9M provision 1.03B vs 22.89B) and TTM FCF yield about 1.75%. The business quality is not in doubt; the price assumes AI capex pays back, and free cash flow is currently thin.
counterthesis: Capex of 135-145B plus 454.5B of commitments is being financed with debt and new equity (preferred plus forward sale), buybacks stopped, FCF yield about 1.75%, Q3 operating income fell 37% (legal charge 9.89B is one-off but infrastructure and AI token costs are structural), 5.3B contingent legal amounts unrecognised, 20.5B long-term tax liabilities, and 10.8B of cash restricted in escrow to 2028-2030. If AI revenue does not justify the spend, returns on capital fall sharply while fixed obligations stay.
invalidation: Treat as a pass if 2027 capex keeps rising faster than operating cash flow with FCF after leases still near zero, or if operating margin ex legal charges keeps falling while revenue growth slows below 15%. Consider deeper study only if FCF after capex recovers toward 5% of market cap with growth near 20%.
